spec.description: Capture a new sales opportunity in WeLead: verify client, draft lead details, ask the member to approve it, then create the lead.

activation.when: Use when the member wants to create or register a new sales lead or business opportunity in WeLead.
examples: Create a lead for Adriti: Aerodynamic analysis for Drone Corp, expected 15 Lakhs.

org.description: Target tenant organization (e.g. adriti or vithi)

steps.description: Look up existing corporate client in WeLead if companyHint is provided.
steps.instruction: Load the welead-workspace skill. If companyHint is provided, use welead__list_clients with search to check if an existing client matches. Record the clientId if found, or empty string if not found. Do not create a client or lead in this step.

steps.description: Draft the lead details for member review.
steps.instruction: From the request input and find-client output, draft one lead: customer_name or company, project_name, expected value in Lakhs, and forecast_stage. Record the drafted values. Do not call create_lead in this step.

steps.description: The member reviews the draft and approves.
steps.question: Create lead '{{steps.draft-lead.output.projectName}}' for '{{steps.draft-lead.output.customerName}}' (₹{{steps.draft-lead.output.valueLakhs}} Lakhs) in WeLead?

steps.instruction: Call welead__create_lead once to create the drafted lead with the customer_name, project_name, value_lakhs, and client_id (if found) exactly as approved. Then report the created lead reference and details to the member.
